title: the update's database step keeps every service's name on the box's networks
note: basis 'shown' means shown on a local container engine (compose 5.7.1, engine 29.9.3) with a two-service project and a stand-in image, and by the card's tests on inspect answers recorded there; the walk on a box (a fresh install, then the candidate to a later bundle) was not run by the card.

findings.claim: a release that changes a network's settings (H-137 gave trialbox-net an address range in deploy/docker-compose.identity.yml) makes compose remove and make that network again at the first up of the whole project, and compose reconnects every container that was on it without its service's name: db then had no name on trialbox-net and the orchestrator could not resolve it (the bench's red; no raw engine call recreates the container, db-up's 'made again' is not the cause)
findings.fix: the database step of db-up (run by the release being installed) first puts the networks on the release's settings with the box's own compose (up --no-start --no-recreate), then recreates through the same compose (up --no-start --no-deps --force-recreate) each service whose container lacks its name on a network; a service still without it stops the update
